meta.note: HLB promotions tagged 'Cards'. `desc` is the bank's listing line; tnc_summary is written from the banner + T&C PDF by summarize_campaign.py or the Console.

promotions.title: 1,200,000 Enrich Points to be won

promotions.title: Win RM2,000 Cashback or a prize of your choice
promotions.desc: Apply & spend with your new HLB Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: HLB Credit Card 'Tap & Pay your way to win' campaign. Tap & Pay spend can win a prize of your choice: RM2,000 cashback, 20,000 Enrich Points, or a RM2,000 Watsons in-store e-voucher. Alternatively, earn up to RM188 cashback. The poster doesn't show minimum spend or a campaign period.
